subject: Isolated infrastructure deep-dive — proposed slot & follow-ups
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Villa <carlos.villa@securecore.com>, it-security@securecore.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Isolated infrastructure deep-dive — proposed slot & prep

Carlos / SecureCore team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, we'd like to run a focused technical deep-dive to cover the feasibility and constraints for a private Redwood deployment behind your VPC (and the air-gapped option you mentioned). Goal is to leave the session with a mutual action plan and a clear list of outstanding artifacts for security review.

Proposed agenda (45–60m):
- Brief intro & scope alignment (5m)
- Network topology & firewall requirements (10m)
- Data flow / residency and KMS integration (10m)
- On‑prem provisioning and agent/air‑gap options (10m)
- Rollout constraints & operational SLOs (5m)
- Action items & next steps (5m)

Availability from our side this week (all PST):
- Thu Feb 11, 10:00–11:00
- Fri Feb 12, 13:00–14:00
- Mon Feb 15, 15:00–16:00

I've attached an isolation checklist and a short provisioning playbook that outline the typical artifacts we ask for ahead of a private deployment. Please share any additional docs (network diagrams, NGFW rules, procurement timelines) that would be helpful.

Attachments: isolation-checklist.pdf, provisioning-playbook.docx

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119
https://redwood.ai
From: Carlos Villa <carlos.villa@securecore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-security@securecore.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Isolated infrastructure deep-dive — proposed slot & prep

Neha,

Appreciate the clear agenda — this looks good. We're keen to get a read on the air‑gapped option specifically; a couple of quick asks from our side before the session:
- Can Redwood list the minimum offline install artifacts (images, manifests) and a rough ETA for initial bring‑up?
- We need to confirm whether Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS integrations in the air‑gapped flow.

Availability from SecureCore:
- Fri Feb 12, 09:00–11:00 PT (overlap with your 13:00 slot — which would be 11:00 our side)
- Mon Feb 15, 14:00–16:00 PT

If Fri 12 at 10:00 PT works for you, let's tentatively lock that. I can loop in our infra lead (Sara Lin) if needed.

Regards,
Carlos Villa
Sr. Manager, IT Security | SecureCore Financial
carlos.villa@securecore.com | +1 (650) 555-2120
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Villa <carlos.villa@securecore.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Isolated infrastructure deep-dive — proposed slot & prep

Carlos — Fri 12 at 10:00 PT works for our engineering lead as well. We'll plan for a 60m slot to allow time for Q&A and a short demo of our network peering approach.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Minimum offline artifacts: OCI image tarballs (signed), runtime manifests, and a compact operator bundle for orchestration. I'll have Aditya paste a short checklist into the meeting notes.
- HSM/KMS: Redwood's private package supports KMS integrations via customer HSM or cloud KMS proxies; the air‑gapped flow requires the HSM to be reachable via an approved control plane (we can discuss options).

I've updated the calendar invite (see link) and attached SecureCore-specific network requirements template for you to complete if helpful.

Attachments: securecore_network_requirements.xlsx
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=securecore-deepdive-20270212

Neha

- Network ports and DMZ recommendations
- How our prefix/caching interacts with private registries in air‑gapped installs
- A short demo (5–7m) of the offline install flow using tarballs and the operator bundle

One ask: can we move the meeting from Fri Feb 12, 10:00 PT to Mon Feb 15, 15:00 PT? We realized the build team has a freeze window Friday morning and won't be able to support the demo properly. Mon 15 at 15:00 PT keeps the same attendees and gives us time to prep.
